reason: Resolve implementation details that depend only on already-open non-response patch-area metadata and the frozen feature definitions, before any population value is opened.

annual_active_node_rule.active_at_t: patch has finite patch_area.tsv area > 0 in source year t
annual_active_node_rule.sources: survey-recorded occupied patches at t intersect active_at_t
annual_active_node_rule.colonization_candidates: survey-recorded unoccupied patches at t with finite response at t+1 intersect active_at_t
annual_active_node_rule.transition_operator_destination_set: only active_at_t destination patches contribute outgoing raw edge support and row-normalization denominator
annual_active_node_rule.inactive_nodes: remain in the immutable 4,656-patch identity universe but receive no destination edge support for that annual transition
annual_active_node_rule.rationale: patch-area dynamics are non-response habitat state; allowing extinct/nonexistent habitat patches to absorb transition mass would be an avoidable structural artifact

eog_one_step_computation.source_weighting: equal normalized weight over current active occupied sources
eog_one_step_computation.row_normalization: Q[s,i]=W[s,i]/(1+sum over active destination k W[s,k])
eog_one_step_computation.candidate_support: mean over current sources of Q[s,i]
eog_one_step_computation.structural_world_raw_support: exp(-d/1km) inside frozen threshold and 0 outside
eog_one_step_computation.process_world_raw_support: exp(-d/1km) for every distinct active source-destination pair

identity_estimability_rule.scope: calibration rows only, before heldout outcomes are scored
identity_estimability_rule.test: after dropping zero-SD EOG feature columns and standardizing on calibration, regress each retained identity-specific EOG feature by ordinary least squares on an intercept plus the 10 declared compression features; compute residual standard deviation
identity_estimability_rule.estimable_if: at least one retained identity-specific feature has residual SD > 1e-8
identity_estimability_rule.no_rescue: do not add axes, nonlinear encodings, or alternative compression after this test

missingness_rule.population: rows with non-finite source-year or target-year population are excluded from that transition
missingness_rule.patch_area: rows without finite positive source-year patch area are excluded from sources/candidates

negative_population_rule: if any finite population value is <0, stop as response-schema-invalid rather than recoding it
